Write a review sheet

Source: R/keyword_review.R
review_sheet.Rd

Writes what needs a human look to a file you can check anywhere and pass back later. For an [authors_clean()] result, see [review_sheet.saqr_authors()]; the rest of this page is about keyword and institution merges.

Writes the pairs to an Excel file for you to check. `decision` is the AI's (see [ask_ai()]); `decision_2` is yours and empty. Where you fill in `decision_2` (`accept`, `reject` or `check`) it overrules `decision`; where you leave it empty, the AI's `decision` stands. Correct `name` (the name both keywords will get) where needed, then pass the file to `keywords_clean(replace = )`.

A `.csv` file is for working on the pairs elsewhere (another program, Python, a spreadsheet): the AI's answers, including the ones hidden in the blind rows, go to a second file beside it, `<name>_ai.csv`. Keep it there for [review_report()]. Both are UTF-8; a sheet saved back with `;` as the separator, as Excel does in many countries, is read as well.

Pairs to `check` come first, then `reject`, then `accept`; within each, the closest in meaning (`cosine`). One in ten accepted or rejected pairs, drawn at random, is shown blind: its `decision` is `check` and the AI's answer is hidden. Your `decision_2` on those tells [review_report()] how often the AI is right.

Usage

review_sheet(x, file)

Arguments

x

An [ask_ai()] result (a [suggest_merges()] result also works; then every pair is `check`), or an [authors_clean()] result.

file

The file to write: `.xlsx` (two sheets, `review` and `ai`) or `.csv` (two files). An existing file is never replaced, since it may hold your decisions.

Value

The file path, invisibly.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` when `file` is not `.xlsx` or `.csv`, or it (or its `_ai.csv`) already exists; `saqrmisc_missing_package` for `.xlsx` without writexl.

See also

[ask_ai()], [review_report()]

Examples

if (requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  papers <- data.frame(DE = c("BEHAVIOR CHANGE; SOCIAL NETWORK",
                              "BEHAVIOUR CHANGE; SOCIAL NETWORKING"))
  file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  review_sheet(suggest_merges(papers, meaning = FALSE), file)
  review_report(file)
}
#> file21ed18c4a865.xlsx: 2 pair(s) to check (0 of them blind), 0 accepted and 0 rejected by the AI. Write yours in decision_2.
#> file21ed18c4a865.xlsx: 2 pairs, 0 accepted, 0 rejected, 2 still to check
#> You decided 0 pair(s) in decision_2, overruling the AI on 0
